chunks: From him, from his father, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) about the engraving on his ring and the ring of his father (peace be upon him). He said: 'The engraving on my ring is:
Whatever Allah willed, there is no strength except by Allah;
and the engraving of my father's ring is: "Allah is Sufficient for me,"
and it is that which I used to wear with.

key_terms.لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ: There is no strength except by Allah

ai.seo_question: What were the inscriptions on the rings of Imam al-Rida and his father?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the distinct spiritual signatures of Imam al-Rida and his father, Imam Musa al-Kadhim, reflecting their unique theological emphases. While Imam al-Rida’s ring invokes divine will and strength (*La quwwata illa billah*), Imam al-Kadim’s ring emphasizes divine sufficiency and trust (*Hasbiya Allah*), a phrase deeply associated with the Prophet’s reliance on God during times of distress. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly view that the Imams’ personal practices serve as living interpretations of Quranic virtues for the community.

en.hubeali:
From him, form his father, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman who said, 
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the engraving on his<sup>asws</sup> ring and the ring of his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The engraving on my<sup>asws</sup> ring is: “Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires. There is no Strength except by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>”; and the engraving of the ring of my father<sup>asws</sup> is: “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Sufficient”, and it is which I (the narrator) used to wear with’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the engraving on his ring and the ring of his father. He (the Imam) said, ‘The engraving on my ring says, ‘It is whatever Allah wants and there is no power except the power of Allah’ and the engraving on the ring of my father said, ‘Allah is sufficient for me’ and it is what I used for my ring.’”
